03 / YOUR PRODUCTION IN THE DRC

A local perspective.
A shared vision.

Congo is more than a location.
It is people, language and lived experience.

Need a local producer for your DRC shoot? Our Kinshasa team can scout locations, coordinate filming permits, hire local crew and plan transport around your schedule.

If your shoot continues across borders, we can coordinate with producers in Zambia and West Africa. Tell us where the story takes you and which days you need on the ground.

05 / ABOUT SILVER ROAD

Congolese stories.
Cinematic craft.

Silver Road Productions is a film and video production company based in Kinshasa.

Our work brings together commercial production, branded content and documentary filmmaking. Director and cinematographer Fanon Kabwe brings experience across advertising, feature films and television.

We collaborate around each project’s creative and production needs, with a belief that strong images begin with a clear story.
